repair_results: RV1: Require a parseable HTTP/HTTPS source URL with hostname, valid port syntax, no whitespace or userinfo on REVIEWED scope and buyer evidence. Store writes reject absent/malformed locators. Direct gate evaluation skips unsourced evidence and fails closed when any active reviewed scope locator is invalid; buyer promotion requires all active buyer evidence to be reviewed and traceable. Other UNKNOWN intake remains available.

RV2: Compare prior/current gate and fuel notes within the SQLite write transaction. An initially locked project cannot add coordination notes. While locked, changed nonempty notes are rejected. Previously saved notes from an unlocked state may be retained after the gate relocks when status is reset to NOT_STARTED; the notes cannot then be changed. Added regression for these paths.

RV3: Removed duplicate client localGate calculation. The UI displays only the gate returned from the server. On a save that adds evidence, it conservatively resets fuel status to NOT_STARTED before submission and consumes the server response after success; it does not optimistically mutate gate state. Added HTTP regression for UNKNOWN buyer returning buyer UNKNOWN and fuel locked.
Evidence correction UI rerenders its dependent same-claim correction options when the claim selector changes, preserving already entered data bound to the current model.
